According to the weather update attributed to Hyderabad Meteorological Department Director Stella, Cyclone Arnab is moving northwest over the west-central Bay of Bengal at around 20 kmph. The system is expected to cross the coast near Yanam, between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam, tomorrow morning. Heavy to very heavy rainfall is likely in Telangana. Residents should monitor official IMD bulletins and follow local authorities’ advisories.

Editorial note: Please verify the cyclone’s official name, current classification and forecast track with the India Meteorological Department (IMD) before publishing.

recentItems.description:
Cyclone Arnab has intensified into a very severe cyclonic storm over the west-central Bay of Bengal. According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), it is expected to cross the Andhra Pradesh–Yanam coast near Yanam by the forenoon of October 28, 2026. Heavy to very heavy rainfall is forecast in parts of Telangana, with extremely heavy rainfall possible in some areas. Residents are advised to follow official weather alerts and local authorities’ instructions. 
India Meteorological Department+1
